VISHAL GOUR

Third Party Risk Management | Business Analysis Mumbai, India | +91 6265 446 341 | vishalprime225@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/vishalgour225

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Results-driven Risk and Business Analysis professional with 5+ years of progressive experience in financial services, including Morgan Stanley (TPRM) and Lloyds Banking Group. Specialist in Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM), Vendor Risk Assessment, RCSA, and Regulatory Compliance across RBI, SEBI, and international frameworks (FCA, EBA). Proven ability to manage end-to-end SDLC, drive Agile project delivery, and partner with senior stakeholders — Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Business Units — to strengthen governance and control environments. Targeting Senior Associate or AVP roles in Risk Management, Business Analysis, or Project Management at leading banks, NBFCs, and financial institutions.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Risk Management: Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) · Vendor Risk Assessment · Operational Risk · RCSA · Risk Control Framework · Audit Remediation · KRI/KPI Monitoring · Basel III · RBI Guidelines · SEBI Regulations Business Analysis: Business Requirements Document (BRD) · Functional Requirements Document (FRD) · System Requirements Document (SRD) · GAP Analysis · Use Case Development · Requirement Traceability Matrix (RTM) · JAD Sessions · Process Re-engineering Project Management: Agile · Scrum · SDLC · JIRA · Confluence · Stakeholder Management · Change Management · Project Planning · UAT / SIT · MIS Reporting Data & Analytics: SQL · Python · Power BI · Tableau · Advanced Excel · SPSS · Data Analysis · Dashboard Reporting · Pipeline Manager · ALM Domain Knowledge: Capital Markets · Trade Lifecycle · NSE · Outsourcing Risk · Inter-Affiliate Risk · Corporate Banking · Investment Banking · Regulatory Reporting · GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance)

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Morgan Stanley Third Party Risk Management (TPRM)

Mumbai, India Apr 2024 – Present

Lead end-to-end vendor due diligence and third-party risk assessments for outsourcing and inter-affiliate arrangements in compliance with RBI Outsourcing Guidelines, FCA, and EBA regulatory frameworks; manage a portfolio of 50+ vendor engagements annually.

Drive Operational Risk and TPRM lifecycle improvements by gathering business requirements and re-engineering workflows — reducing average due diligence cycle time and improving MIS reporting accuracy for senior risk committees.

Act as the central coordination point for cross-functional teams including Legal, Compliance, Business Units, and External Auditors to ensure consistent application of internal governance policies and regulatory requirements. • Prepare and present ad-hoc risk analytics, KRI dashboards, and management information reports to C-suite and Risk Committee stakeholders, enabling data-driven risk decisions.

Manage RCSA (Risk and Control Self-Assessment) cycles, audit issue remediation tracking, and policy/procedure reviews under the Risk Control Framework (RCF), supporting first-line-of-defence oversight.

Lloyds Banking Group Business Analyst / Risk Analyst

Glasgow, UK Mar 2023 – Nov 2023

Partnered with the Project Manager to define project charter, scope, milestones, and governance structures for risk- domain initiatives in alignment with Agile/Scrum delivery methodology.

Facilitated JAD sessions to elicit and baseline business requirements; produced comprehensive BRDs, FRDs, and SRDs stored in the Knowledge Link repository for audit and compliance traceability.

Identified process inefficiency through root-cause data analysis and collaborated with developers to deliver an automated operational support tool — saving 60+ hours per quarter (approx. 15% productivity improvement).

Tata Consultancy Services Business Analyst

Mumbai, India Sep 2019 – Oct 2021 • Executed end-to-end requirements analysis for National Stock Exchange (NSE), India's largest stock exchange,

delivering BRDs, FRDs, Use Cases, Change Requests, and RTMs covering Capital Markets and Trade Lifecycle modules. • Served as primary SPOC (Single Point of Contact) between NSE business stakeholders and TCS development teams —

managed scope, change control, and stakeholder communication across full SDLC.

Planned and executed Pre-UAT and UAT test cycles, authored Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and maintained Issue Track Log ensuring zero critical defects at production go-live.

Supported QA team during SIT phases; validated test scenarios, functional reports, and regression test cases, ensuring application quality and compliance with client specifications.

EDUCATION

Strathclyde Business School MSc – Business Analysis & Consulting

Glasgow, UK Jan 2022 – Jan 2023 Key Modules: Quantitative Business Analysis · Risk Analysis · Strategy Modelling · Spreadsheet Modelling · Managing Business Operations · Decision Analysis Live Consulting Projects: Delivered data-driven business solutions for Deloitte, Valentia Partners, WHO, and DSTL using SWOT, PESTEL, MCDA, SODA, and SPSS frameworks.

Rustamji Institute of Technology (RGPV University) B.Tech – Computer Science & Engineering

Gwalior, India Jul 2015 – Jun 2019

CERTIFICATIONS

Jan 2024: Career Essentials in Business Analysis — Microsoft Dec 2023: Business Analyst Workshop — Udemy

KEY ACHIEVEMENTS

Managed 50+ third-party vendor risk engagements at Morgan Stanley ensuring 100% regulatory audit readiness. • Delivered a process automation tool at Lloyds Banking Group saving 240+ man-hours annually (60 hrs/quarter). • Successfully led NSE (National Stock Exchange) digital platform enhancement as SPOC at TCS, delivering zero critical go-live defects.

Completed postgraduate consulting projects for global organizations including WHO and Deloitte using advanced analytical frameworks.
